# Chat control icon sources

The compose, sidebar, sidebar-search, plus and settings-cog SVG symbols were copied from the public sprite referenced by the user's open ChatGPT web page, as explicitly requested:
https://chatgpt.com/cdn/assets/sprites-shell-f705d3e2.svg

Only these five interface symbols are included in public/icons/chat-controls.svg. No account data, conversations, scripts, branding logos or ChatGPT service code is copied. This note records provenance and does not assert an open-source license for the asset.
